newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brahma - no comment on report of Baesa deal.
newsitem.headline: Brahma - no comment on report of Baesa deal.

text.p: Companhia Cervejaria Brahma SA on Thursday declined comment on a press report that it agreed to buy Buenos Aires Embotelladora SA's (Baesa) Brazilian operations.
"The company is not making any comments on that issue," said a spokeswoman for Brahma, Brazil's largest brewer.
The daily Jornal do Brasil reported in its Wednesday's editions that Brahma would buy Baesa's operations in Brazil for 150 million reais.
Baesa, the biggest PepsiCo Inc bottler outside the United States, has the exclusive Pepsi and Seven-Up franchises for Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Costa Rica and Brazil.

If Brahma acquired the Baesa's Brazilian operations, it would regain its rights to distribute Pepsi in the country, according to press reports. Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said Brahma was the Pepsi bottler in Brazil until late 1994.
Equity analysts said Brahma would benefit from a purchase of Baesa's operations in Brazil.
